title: Companion retained media bundle binding
description: Use an isolated gate fixture with a blue retained image and red newer current image at the same task-relative path. Open the full gate review with filters visible. Set FARMSLOT_BUNDLE_PROOF_SCREENSHOT to this run artifact directory/native-retained-media.png; ffmpeg and od must be available. No real gate action or judgment. Remove owned proof resources after receipts.

proofTargets.claim: The captured gate displays the retained blue image after newer output is captured.

show-unassigned.intent: Show media without an AC binding in the existing gate review.

open-unassigned.intent: Open the Unassigned ordinary image through the recorded viewer.

unassigned-title.intent: The viewer shows the Unassigned image instead of the previous video.

unassigned-index.intent: The Unassigned image uses its one-item recorded selection.

hud-capture-unassigned.intent: The old gate must keep its captured blue image after current output turns red.

capture-unassigned.intent: Record the Unassigned image in its own gallery.

close-unassigned.intent: Return without changing the gate or evidence.

read-displayed-pixel.intent: Read the displayed image pixel from the actual native screenshot.

assert-retained-blue.intent: The visible image is retained blue, never current red.
